sentence: Among early-stage ventures, strategic resilience carries the entire link between AI capability and entrepreneurial success, and the authors read the mechanism as organizational, not technological
passage: [Wang & Zhang (2026), p. 1] "The mediating effect of strategic resilience is robust and fully accounts for the AI capability--success relationship, indicating that the mechanism through which AI investments generate performance returns is fundamentally organizational rather than technological in nature."

gemini.note: The passage supports the claims regarding full mediation and the organizational mechanism, but it does not mention that this applies specifically to early-stage ventures.
